name: hud
description: A heads-up display under or above the prompt: model, branch, context and plan limits, memory headroom, and the live tool, subagents and errors of the running turn. /hud opens the full view

band.title: Band
band.description: What the band above the prompt shows: panel (two rows with bars), line (one compact row) or off. Use off with the status line script, which draws the panel under the prompt

activity.title: Activity
activity.description: While a turn runs, show the tool in flight, the running subagents and the turn's calls and errors under the band

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Show how much memory still fits before the tightest cgroup limit, or the machine's when there is none

datasetDir.title: Ratings dataset
datasetDir.description: Folder of the rating mod's dataset, read for the RATINGS row of /hud. The row hides when the folder is missing

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone for the times shown and for what counts as today, such as America/New_York. Empty uses the system time zone.
